title: Inventory: UI Manifest
description: Consolidated UI structure with route mapping — generated during legacy scan Stage 1 when screens detected. Output: .mc-data/work/legacy-scan/inventory/ui-manifest.json

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp khi manifest duoc tao

project_root.description: Root directory cua frontend app — vd: '' (root), 'apps/frontend/', 'src/'. Monorepo: moi app co project_root rieng

name.description: Framework name — vd: nextjs, react, vue, angular

version.description: Phien ban chinh — vd: '14.2', '18.0'. 'unknown' neu khong detect duoc

frameworks.description: Frameworks phat hien duoc va so screens tuong ung

total_screens.description: Tong so screens (bao gom infrastructure screens)

total_routes.description: Tong so unique routes phat hien duoc

empty_project.description: true khi khong co screens nao (screen_count == 0). Downstream skills skip khi true

path.description: Relative path tu project root — vd: 'app/users/page.tsx'

type.description: Loai UI element — phan loai tu filename

route.description: URL route tuong ung — vd: '/users', '/users/[id]'. null neu khong detect duoc route

route_source.description: Nguon route detection — file-system cho Next.js App/Pages Router, jsx-route cho React Router JSX, config-object cho createBrowserRouter, decorator cho Angular

route_group.description: Next.js route group — vd: 'admin' tu app/(admin)/users/page.tsx. null neu khong co

parallel_slot.description: Next.js parallel route slot — vd: 'modal' tu app/@modal/(.)photo/[id]/page.tsx. null neu khong co

intercepts.description: Intercepted route — vd: '/photo/[id]' khi dung intercepting routes. null neu khong co

module_hint.description: Goi y module tu directory structure — vd: 'users' tu app/users/page.tsx

child_screens.description: Danh sach paths cua screens con (sub-routes)

is_modal.description: true neu screen la modal (parallel slot hoac directory modals/)

is_layout.description: true neu screen la layout file (layout.tsx, _app.tsx)

screens.description: Danh sach screens voi route mapping

infrastructure_screens.description: Screens ha tang — layout, error, loading, not-found, default, template, global-error, middleware, _app, _document, opengraph-image, sitemap, robots, favicon, icon, apple-icon, route (API). Khong tinh vao coverage

path.description: Duong dan file cau hinh route

route_config_files.description: Files cau hinh route — vd: router.ts, app-routing.module.ts, app.config.ts

screens_without_routes.description: Screens khong tim thay route (config-based routing co the miss)

routes_without_screens.description: Routes tu config khong tim thay screen file tuong ung

infrastructure_count.description: Screens ha tang (khong tinh vao business coverage)

_coverage_invariant.description: Invariant kiem tra: total_screens = screens_with_routes + screens_without_routes
